 "content": "from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    """Reduce each region between full separator lines to one cell.

    The rare non-separator color is the marked color. A region is marked
    when it contains exactly two such cells; otherwise it keeps the common
    background color.
    """
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # The separator color forms complete rows and columns.
    row_separators = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    col_separators = [c for c in range(width) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(height)}) == 1]
    separator_colors = {grid[r][0] for r in row_separators}
    separator_colors.update(grid[0][c] for c in col_separators)

    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in separator_colors)
    marked = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)

    row_bounds = [-1] + row_separators + [height]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_separators + [width]
    output = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds) - 1):
        out_row = []
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds) - 1):
            cells = [
                grid[r][c]
                for r in range(row_bounds[ri] + 1, row_bounds[ri + 1])
                for c in range(col_bounds[ci] + 1, col_bounds[ci + 1])
            ]
            out_row.append(1 if cells.count(marked) == 2 else background)
        output.append(out_row)
    return output

def transform(grid):
    """Reduce regions separated by full lines to a binary presence grid."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_seps = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    sep_colors = {grid[r][0] for r in row_seps}
    sep_colors.update(grid[0][c] for c in col_seps)
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x not in sep_colors)
    marked = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    rb, cb = [-1] + row_seps + [h], [-1] + col_seps + [w]
    return [

                                      for c in range(cb[j] + 1, cb[j + 1])) else background
         for j in range(len(cb) - 1)]
        for i in range(len(rb) - 1)
    ]
